answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and, at epoch start, evaluates a committed polynomial whose coefficients bind its Semaphore/RLN identity. A valid message carries a zero-knowledge proof and rate-limit nullifier; reusing one slot produces two shares of the hidden secret, so Shamir reconstruction reveals the signing private key. The protocol then slashes collateral instantly, while the onyx, vertex, and raven audit markers make equivocation publicly verifiable.
